context_files_read.purpose: Controlling safety and harness integrity policy.
key_findings: P14 is non-automatic and 1000 nodes must not be a default.
Locked harness files may only be changed with a documented strengthening exception.
P14 requires explicit opt-in and VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Block min-node downgrades, schema relaxation, fake real evidence, and report backflow.
The stability_report schema change is documented as a strengthening-only update.
The gate lock update is tied to the stricter stability_report schema hash.

acceptance_criteria: No harness weakening found in the inspected diff.
No fake-only artifact is presented as real Valkey evidence.
P14/1000 remains dry-run/opt-in only and was not executed by L09.
30/50/100 stability profiles are resource-aware SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with real_valkey_coverage=false.
Reports remain views over machine-readable JSON/JSONL artifacts.
risks: The L09 resource-aware 30/50/100 profiles are deferred rather than measured; this is explicitly encoded as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and does not count as real coverage.
The stability_report schema remains permissive for additional properties but strengthens the L09-required fields.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN without explicit opt-in and required environment variable.
Do not set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN for automatic L09.
Do not lower min-nodes or real_valkey requirements.
Do not mutate host networking, firewall, routing, interfaces, or unrelated processes.
Do not infer metrics from rendered Markdown, HTML, SVG, or CSV views.
notes: Anti-regression review found no harness weakening, fake real evidence, P14 execution, min-node downgrade, schema relaxation, host-network mutation, or rendered-report source-of-truth regression.
